name: Senzoku-Ike
tagline: Shibuya in 26 minutes and Shinagawa in 26 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Tokyu Ikegami Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 39 minutes to Otemachi, 34 minutes to Shinjuku, 26 minutes to Shibuya and 26 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 22.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 18.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 22.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 13.7 m to 32.3 m, a difference of 18.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 14 clinics and 8 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 荏原病院, about 11 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 中原病院, about 13 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Ikegami Line.
congestion: Tokyu Ikegami Line runs at 130% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大崎広小路→五反田, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Ishikawadai is ahead on quiet, but Senzoku-Ike is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
